name: Beef in tamarind
summary: Thin beef dipped at the table into a sweet-sour tamarind sauce on a hot pan. VnExpress calls it a newer plate in town. The price now is Check on arrival.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 says bò nhúng me had appeared in Buon Ma Thuot in the few years before that article.
howToEat: The portion comes on a pan. Staff have you brush butter on the pan, pour sweet-sour tamarind sauce and onion, wait until it barely boils, then dip thin beef and vegetables. The article says dumping everything in at once makes the beef tough and dulls the smell.
It prints 150,000 VND a portion on Lê Thánh Tông. The price now is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Lê Thánh Tông. A door number is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bo nhung me in Buon Ma Thuot — beef in tamarind
seoDescription: Thin beef dipped into sweet-sour tamarind on a hot pan, on Le Thanh Tong. A 2021 article prints 150,000 VND. The price now is Check on arrival.
